Keywords: Pepper and white goods at Guzang
RagShortTexts: Pepper and other stock waited at Guzang while caravans failed to depart.

Variants.Content: The Guzang letter lists white goods, pepper, other consignments and a small quantity of silver awaiting dispatch. Stock could not become delivered revenue while no caravan departed. The account organized goods by bundles and measures; having merchandise on a Silk Road did not ensure movement.
